Data:Relevance.rose.json.label: Relevance: Rose
Data:Relevance.rose.json.desc: Relevant to visitors with an interest in horizons.

Data:Relevance.scale.json.label: Relevance: Scale
Data:Relevance.scale.json.desc: Relevant to visitors with an interest in ancient profundities.

Data:Relevance.sky.json.label: Relevance: Sky
Data:Relevance.sky.json.desc: Relevant to visitors with an interest in the songs of earth and heaven.

xexts.scrutiny: Its sigils evolve with age… but it ages so very slowly.

Data:Relic.living.json.Label: Living Relic
Data:Relic.living.json.Desc: Few of these have been seen in the world under this sun.

xexts.scrutiny: Its sigils evolve with age… but it ages so very slowly.

Data:Reluctant.json.label: Reluctant
Data:Reluctant.json.desc: Someone who will provide help... but only essential help.
Data:Reluctant.json.comments: use to lock out Assistance from usual behaviour. In particular, this locks out the intro fisherman from Second Beach (though he doesn't have the Powers anyway) and from a shift-click sending him to Sweet Bones when the village is still shrouded (though we could do with a proper solution / seed for that!)

Data:Remains.json.label: Remains
Data:Remains.json.desc: This is how you know who was mortal.

Data:Reminder.rhonwen.act1.json.label: A Reminder to the Librarian
Data:Reminder.rhonwen.act1.json.desc: A reminder from St Rhonwen's Trust that I hadn't yet replied to them.

xexts.reading．correspondence: The Trust hopes I've arrived safely, but wonders why, if so, I haven't yet replied. The letter is signed simply 'the Trustees'.

Data:Remove.contamination.actinic.json.label: Dispel Actinic Theoplasma
Data:Remove.contamination.actinic.json.startdescription: The Westcott Method. The process has been refined over the years, and no-longer requires tobacco-smoke. If indeed it ever really did.
Data:Remove.contamination.actinic.json.desc: 'The Sun is Gold, the Forge is Red.' [The Actinic Theoplasma contamination has been removed.]

Data:Remove.contamination.bloodlines.jso.label: Purge Bloodlines Infestation
Data:Remove.contamination.bloodlines.jso.startdescription: Each word must be treated separately.
Data:Remove.contamination.bloodlines.jso.desc: 'Where does the blood come from? The Grail knows. Where does it go? The Moth remembers.' [The Bloodlines contamination has been removed.]

Data:Remove.contamination.chionic.json.label: Attenuate Chionic Theoplasma
Data:Remove.contamination.chionic.json.startdescription: The Dewulf Method. Some credit it to Gideon, others to Eva.
Data:Remove.contamination.chionic.json.desc: The problem with a direct approach to theoplasmic attenuation is that if we call on any of the Hours, we may end up theoplasmed worse than when we started... so we need to go carefully.  [The Chionic Theoplasma contamination has been removed.]

Data:Remove.contamination.curse.fifth.ey.label: Lift Fifth Eye Curse
Data:Remove.contamination.curse.fifth.ey.startdescription: The principle of Heart can abate the curse's malice. There's a cruder technique that relies on Winter, but that's how you end up with a chionic theoplasma problem.
Data:Remove.contamination.curse.fifth.ey.desc: 'When the sun was always red and low, we needed all our eyes. Now, Glory enters mercilessly if we open them unwisely.' [The Fifth Eye Curse has been lifted.]

Data:Remove.contamination.keeperskin.jso.label: Treat Keeperskin Corruption
Data:Remove.contamination.keeperskin.jso.startdescription: Keeperskin is persistent, but it has its weaknesses.
Data:Remove.contamination.keeperskin.jso.desc: Thirza Blake theorised that keeperskin was a debased Carapace-kind - or perhaps its young. But she never could convince it to speak. [The keeperskin contamination has been removed.]

Data:Remove.contamination.sthenic.taint..label: Resolve Sthenic Taint
Data:Remove.contamination.sthenic.taint..startdescription: The van Lauren Method. Gervinus van Lauren perfected it in the last years of the Cucurbit Prison. Even then, Hush House did more good than harm.
Data:Remove.contamination.sthenic.taint..desc: 'To each serpent, its cure.' [The Sthenic Taint has been removed.]

Data:Remove.contamination.winkwell.json.label: Suppress Winkwell Corruption
Data:Remove.contamination.winkwell.json.startdescription: The softest edge of the Velvet's cloaking darkness - invoked carefully through the Black Flower of the Watchman's Tree - is a certain cure for winkwell.
Data:Remove.contamination.winkwell.json.desc: There have been many theories about what winkwell is, and why. But the Velvet is an Hour of secrets, and if we question her too closely, she might withdraw her protection. [The Winkwell contamination has been removed.]

Data:Remove.contamination.witchworms.jso.label: Quell Witchworm Contamination
Data:Remove.contamination.witchworms.jso.startdescription: The softest penumbra of the Madrugad's light - invoked carefully through the White Flower of the Watchman's Tree - drives witchworms to twitching death.
Data:Remove.contamination.witchworms.jso.desc: Horrible little things. I can be glad that their screams are almost inaudible. [The witchworm infestation has been removed.]

Data:Reply.rhonwen.act1.json.label: A Reply to the Trust
Data:Reply.rhonwen.act1.json.desc: I can take this to the Post Office to be dispatched to St Rhonwen's Trust. Once they know I've arrived, they'll send more funds... I hope.

xexts.posting: Now I can expect visitors, correspondence, and a stipend from the Trust every spring.

Data:Request.catalogue.oriflammes.json.label: A Request for a Catalogue
Data:Request.catalogue.oriflammes.json.desc: A brief but courteous letter requesting the latest catalogue from Oriflamme's Auction House.

Data:Requesting.json.label: Requesting
Data:Requesting.json.desc: (recipe aspect) Spawns requests from contact addresses

Data:Rest.sweetbones.autumn.json.label: Rest and Refreshment: Autumn
Data:Rest.sweetbones.autumn.json.startdescription: It is Autumn when the leaves rustle. The silent landlady has served me apple pie with steamed cream in the window-nook.

Data:Rest.sweetbones.general.json.label: Rest and Refreshment
Data:Rest.sweetbones.general.json.startdescription: Quiet grey light through a quiet grey window...

Data:Rest.sweetbones.numa.json.label: The Refreshments of the Labyrinth Season
Data:Rest.sweetbones.numa.json.startdescription: The inn is crowded with Numa's heralds and pilgrims. Their meat is unfamiliar; their drink is unknown. As I linger at the window, an electric bulb flares like a marsh-light: a guest raises her glinting eyes and sees me. She beckons me in with a gloved hand.

Data:Rest.sweetbones.numa.malady.json.startdescription: I have eaten, I have drunk. A cloying taste lingers. My lips are stained with grey.

Data:Rest.sweetbones.spring.json.label: Rest and Refreshment: Spring
Data:Rest.sweetbones.spring.json.startdescription: It is Spring; and the landlady has served me a slice of her starygazy pie, with the pilchard-heads poking cheekily through the hot crust.

Data:Rest.sweetbones.summer.json.label: Rest and Refreshment: Summer
Data:Rest.sweetbones.summer.json.startdescription: It is Summer; I am sitting on the bench outside the Sweet Bones, eating crumbly cheese in nettle wrappings and good black rye bread, soaking up the sun.

Data:Rest.sweetbones.try.json.label: Rest and Refreshment
Data:Rest.sweetbones.try.json.startdescription: Tuppence will buy me a hearty meal and a quiet place where I can rest and gather my thoughts.

Data:Rest.sweetbones.winter.json.label: Rest and Refreshment: Winter
Data:Rest.sweetbones.winter.json.startdescription: It is Winter and the storms have tightened the seas. I am sitting before the fire in the Sweet Bones with a beef and potato pasty in one hand, and a hot ale posset in the other.

Data:Restorative.json.label: Restorative
Data:Restorative.json.desc: For rest and recovery. [Something that will help you recover from Maladies if you use it in bed with sufficient suitable Power aspects - especially, but not exclusively, if it has useful Power aspects itself.]
